scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:reset:clean: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migrate && cd server && node scripts/seed_clean.js
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U aptiquiz_user -d aptiquiz
scripts.live: npm run build && cd server && node scripts/live.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
